concept_ko: 25~26세의 젊은 성인. 은회색 낮은 포니테일과 회색 눈. 가벼운 비대칭 정찰 망토, 슬림한 전술 바지와 경량 장갑. 신형 정밀 사격 화기. 가터벨트 없음.

arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Dear Human squad character illustration, revision 002, correcting the rejected first concept.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, the first concept of this specific squadmate. Input image 2: Lian, STYLE AND UNIFORM-FAMILY REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target.
Primary request: the user rejected the first concepts as too old-looking and their firearms as too antiquated. Make this character clearly a beautiful YOUNG ADULT aged 25–26 in appearance, and give her genuinely new near-future military equipment. Rebuild the face for the correct age rather than preserving the target's facial maturity. Keep this character's distinct hair-color family and role identity.
Shared visual language: polished realistic anime-influenced cinematic 3D-render illustration consistent with Lian, adult human anatomy and natural skin/hair, black/gunmetal technical composite armor with restrained thin gold accents and limited grey insets. Cleaner newer manufactured surfaces, far fewer scratches and chips, avoid antique riveted plate armor and ornate ceremonial styling. A single biological female enhanced-clone soldier, no cybernetic limbs.
Composition: one person, full body head to both boot soles with comfortable margins, entire equipment visible, calm three-quarter standing pose. Same unobtrusive charcoal studio backdrop and subtle contact shadow. Softer flattering broad key light, open facial shadows and delicate cool rim separation; do not use harsh aged-looking facial sculpting or deep brow shadows.
Role-specific uniforms must differ clearly. The user explicitly requests GARTER BELT ONLY ON IREN THE ASSAULT TROOPER, not on the other three. All three other roles wear functional opaque trousers. Keep the scene nonsexual.
Constraints: no text, numbers, invented official codes or rank insignia; no watermark; no second person; no collage; no firing, no gore, no ghost or dead person, no mask covering the face. No generic toy laser guns, no magic energy shields, no historic firearm carry handles or Vietnam-era rifle styling. No wrinkles, grey aging streaks, eye bags, harsh angry scowl or middle-aged appearance. No chibi or childlike body. Preserve the overall high-quality shared world, not the mistakes of revision 001.

SENA / marksman-observer. Preserve her ash-silver LOW ponytail and grey eyes as intentional hair color, but REPLACE the mature-looking face with a fresh youthful adult 25–26-year-old face: clear bright eyes, naturally fuller youthful cheeks, smooth under-eye area and relaxed brow. Not a teenager. Design a genuinely specialized light reconnaissance/marksman uniform: slim matte technical combat trousers, lightweight knee and shin armor, fitted modular chest protection, subtle optics/observation pouches, a short asymmetric field cape with a restrained patterned inner lining, compact practical silhouette. NO garter belt, NO suspender straps, NO stockings, NO bare thighs; opaque tactical trousers cover both legs.
REPLACE the old gun with a sleek new near-future precision rifle: monolithic angular graphite receiver and fore-end, clean enclosed barrel shroud, modular contemporary stock, integrated compact digital optical sight, recessed slim interface details, restrained metal accents. It should immediately read as advanced 2114 military equipment, not an old M16/AR receiver with a scope pasted on. No historical carry handle, no triangular front sight tower, no tubular Vietnam-era handguard, no wood. Long precision-weapon silhouette remains readable. Carry it safely in both hands, lowered diagonally, complete rifle within frame.
